content: The fastest vertical proof order is reproducible upstream baseline and security, then one H.264 4:2:0 1080p path, then 4K60 NVFBC/NVENC with existing stage metrics, then host/client capability negotiation and fallback matrix, then native macOS VideoToolbox/Metal player, then immersive input, then bidirectional text/HTML clipboard. Each phase preserves a runnable end-to-end slice and gates later work on lower-layer evidence.
